description: This file provides database access functions for a Todo application, including schema setup, CRUD operations for todos, and database connection management.

methods.name: str get_dsn()
methods.description: Returns the fixed PostgreSQL DSN string for database connection.

methods.name: psycopg.Connection _connect()
methods.description: Establishes and returns a new psycopg database connection using the DSN.

methods.name: None ensure_schema()
methods.description: Creates the todos table and trigger if they do not exist, ensuring schema setup.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] query_all_todos()
methods.description: Retrieves all todos ordered by id.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] query_todo_by_id(todo_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a single todo by its id, returning None if not found.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] insert_todo(title: str, description: str = "", completed: bool = False)
methods.description: Inserts a new todo record with given title, description, and completion status.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_todo( todo_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, description: Optional[str] = None, completed: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Updates specified fields of an existing todo identified by todo_id.

methods.name: bool delete_todo(todo_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a todo record by its id, returning success status.

ctags.name: insert_todo
ctags.pattern: /^def insert_todo(title: str, description: str = "", completed: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
ctags.signature: (title: str, description: str = "", completed: bool = False)

ctags.name: update_todo
ctags.signature: ( todo_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, description: Optional[str] = None, completed: Optional[bool] = None, )
